summary: Iteration 19 tested Obserra deployment package endpoints, docs downloads, and PWA installability. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend Settings → Deployment & Documentation card renders for admin with three working download buttons, each triggering 200 responses with correct content-types (application/zip, application/pdf, wordprocessingml docx). Service worker /push-sw.js registers and reaches 'activated' state; /manifest.json returns 200 JSON with display=standalone, start_url=/app, 4 icons. Regression on Settings (branding-preview-img, branding-accent, branding-reset) verified visible.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy.py streams zip in-memory: acceptable for current small package (~7 files) but for larger bundles consider caching the zip on disk or precomputing at startup.

guide.pdf/docx endpoints only check auth (get_current_user) but not admin role — any authenticated user could download the guides. Task spec explicitly requires admin auth for all three deploy endpoints; if intended, add role check to guide endpoints too. (Currently only onprem-package enforces role==admin.)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Deploy endpoints: /api/deploy/onprem-package (admin-only, returns zip with obserra-onprem/ containing 7 files incl .env.example), /api/deploy/guide.pdf & /api/deploy/guide.docx (auth-only — NOT admin-gated in code; task spec asked for admin gating so worth confirming intent). PWA: SW at /push-sw.js registers on load; manifest at /manifest.json. Settings deployment-docs-settings card has download-onprem / download-guide-pdf / download-guide-docx buttons.
